Needs changes before merge. Four blocking findings remain.

The worker keeps world access on the session thread. Finished commands use History. The three supplied regression tests pass.

Requested before merge:

1. **Limit workers after cancellation — `crates/app/src/mcp/background.rs:107`.** Cancellation removes `running`, but the detached worker still owns its job and continues. Each retry can start another worker. The held-worker probe made eight generate/cancel pairs and found eight live `mcp-generate` threads. There is no limit. With the long jobs from #3035, retries can exhaust CPU and memory and lose an unsaved document. Keep cancelled workers in a finite worker budget until they finish. Add a repeated cancel/retry test.

2. **Limit the input queue — `crates/app/src/mcp/background.rs:269`.** The reader sends complete lines through an unbounded channel. It reads ahead even when the session cannot write its first response. The probe queued all 1,000 input lines while that response was blocked. Each permitted line can approach 16 MiB. A large input stream can therefore exhaust memory. Bound the queued input and stop reading when that limit is reached. Add a test with blocked output.

3. **Keep null-name generation in the background path — `crates/app/src/mcp/background.rs:240`.** `generate_call` rejects `{"name":null}`, but the synchronous handler accepts it as an unnamed generate. While a named generate was held, this second call returned success before the worker was released. It bypassed the busy refusal. A slow call in this form also blocks reads, saves and cancellation again. Normalize the optional null value, or refuse it. Apply background dispatch and the busy check to every accepted generate form.

4. **Return output errors without waiting for input EOF — `crates/app/src/mcp/background.rs:271`.** When the output writer returns `BrokenPipe`, the scope waits for its reader thread. That thread can remain blocked on open input. The probe got no return within two seconds; `serve` returned only after input closed. Arrange the reader lifetime so an output error can end `serve` without another input byte. Add an output-error test with input left open.

Local build and tests:

- Trial merge: `afbf9a1e60a36e4f45c2949e15aa69c07b38e4bc`, against upstream/main `f2aa981b51a3453428fb294c6c71c575a0178ef6`. `HEAD^1` is the reviewed PR head.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 169 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. The build passed.
- Included suites: `example_catalog` 39 passed, 4 ignored; `mcp` 39 passed; `mcp_generate` 2 passed; `mcp_live` 14 passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 12 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- All light test targets ran through `cargo xtask gate light --only 'motion light:' --only 'app light:'`: 5 steps, 0 failed. Motion lib: 7 passed. `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, `adaptive_troch_parallel` and app `pocket_pass_start`: 1 passed each. The broad prebuild step was excluded; each target built through `cargo test`.
- Full heavy lanes: not run, as current upstream AGENTS.md requires for this P3 review. The heavy dry run reported 63 reached app steps. No current-head heavy record was present.

Extra suites run:

A temporary Cargo package under `/tmp/review-3860-probe-cargo` used this review worktree's target directory. No probe or evidence file was added to the PR tree.

- `cargo test --offline --manifest-path /tmp/review-3860-probe-cargo/Cargo.toml --target-dir /home/mikekinney/Camcraft/.claude/worktrees/review-3860/target -j 12 --test background -- --test-threads=1`: 3 supplied pins passed; the four probes above failed.
- The `streams` target failed both probes on the trial merge. Both passed on source that exactly matched bare upstream/main `f2aa981b5`. `git diff --exit-code upstream/main -- .` confirmed that baseline before the run.
- No fixture or importer change required the additional fixture-reader or kernel suites.

Observed probe failures:

```text
cancel/retry retained 8 live generate workers; all jobs still own staged data
reader prefetched 1000 request lines while the first response was blocked
a second generate bypassed the busy guard: isError=false
serve waited for input EOF after an output error: Err(Timeout)
```

Mutations rerun locally:

- Removed the `still_current` guard: `background_generate::a_generate_whose_operation_changed_meanwhile_is_discarded` failed.
- Ignored cancellation: `background_generate::a_cancelled_generate_gets_no_answer_and_lands_nothing` failed.
- Restored the source: all 3 pins passed again. The final worktree has no code changes.

Goldens moved: none. No recorded program changed. No UI file changed, so screenshots are not required. The PR correctly uses `Refs #3035` for partial work.

The review worktree and branch remain in place to retain the build cache. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
This PR has no linked issue. Please name the issue it closes, with `Fixes #N` or `Refs #N` in the body. The PR cannot carry the P label until then.

Addressed:

- Cancelled workers keep the single worker slot until they finish. Pin: `background_generate::cancelled_workers_keep_the_worker_budget_until_they_finish`.
- The input channel has capacity one and applies backpressure. Pin: `background_streams::blocked_output_bounds_the_input_queue`.
- Null names and all accepted non-null IDs use background dispatch and its busy check. Pin: `background_generate::a_null_name_uses_the_background_lane_and_busy_guard`.
- Output errors return without waiting for input EOF. Pin: `background_streams::an_output_error_returns_while_input_remains_open`.

Each fix failed its pin when removed and passed after restoration. The accepted-ID dispatch mutation also failed and passed after restoration.

New head: `c83ab4889bc8455306a74827b6c6f9a13e3ba308`.

Final-head quick gate: 169 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. App clippy passed with `--all-targets -- -D warnings`. The catalog passed with no program changes.

The required heavy gate ran: 64 steps, 1 failed, 0 stalled. `pocket3d_hsm::the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean` failed its Linux mesh pin: 5,232 triangles versus 6,228 expected. This round leaves that test and fixture unchanged. The PR body records the commands and results. The worktree remains in place for the next round.

Please re-review this head.

Needs changes before merge. The four earlier findings are fixed. One NEW blocker remains: a crash.

## Earlier findings (review of `91e412fdc`)

1. **Limit workers after cancellation: fixed.** A cancelled run keeps the single worker slot until its worker finishes (`background.rs:105`, `:175`). Pin: `background_generate::cancelled_workers_keep_the_worker_budget_until_they_finish`. I ran the mutation again (see below).
2. **Limit the input queue: fixed.** The event channel has capacity one (`background.rs:278`). Pin: `background_streams::blocked_output_bounds_the_input_queue`. I ran the mutation again (see below).
3. **Null-name generation in the background path: fixed.** `name: null` and each non-null id use the background lane and the busy guard (`background.rs:246`, `:259`). Pin: `background_generate::a_null_name_uses_the_background_lane_and_busy_guard`. I also probed `name: ""`: the synchronous handler refuses it (`generate: no operation named ''`) and no generation starts.
4. **Output error without input EOF: fixed.** The reader thread owns its input and is not joined (`background.rs:283`). Pin: `background_streams::an_output_error_returns_while_input_remains_open`.

The request of NeoTech for a linked issue is done: the body ends with `Refs #3035`.

## Requested before merge

1. **NEW blocker (P1 class: crash, loss of the unsaved document) - `crates/app/src/mcp/background.rs:135`.**
   An unnamed `generate` puts `(name, Entity)` pairs in `Running.queue`. The session answers other calls while the worker runs. A `delete_operation` of a queued operation during that time leaves a dead `Entity` in the queue. When the worker lands, `advance` calls `status_of(&self.env.world, &entity)` on the dead entity and the process stops.

   Probe (added locally to `background_generate.rs`, then removed):

   ```rust
   let s = one_face();
   s.ok(4, "add_operation", json!({ "kind": "Face", "name": "Second", "tool": "EM-0400-2FL" }));
   s.call(10, "generate", json!({}));
   s.ok(11, "delete_operation", json!({ "name": "Second" }));
   s.release();
   let done = s.next();
   ```

   Results on the trial merge:

   ```text
   debug:   (signal: 6, SIGABRT: process abort signal)
   release: (signal: 11, SIGSEGV: invalid memory reference)
   ```

   The crash is after `release()` and before an answer for id 10. With a local re-resolve of the entity by name in `advance` (`model::find_by_name`, skip the operation if it is gone), the same probe passed: id 10 answered with `First` generated.

   Why the earlier review did not find it: that review did not probe a world change between two operations of one queue. The fix commits did not change this line. It blocks a re-review because it is a crash that a client can start with three legal calls.

   Class of the defect: an `Entity` handle that is kept across calls of other tools. Please close the whole class with one rule: the lane keeps names only, and resolves each entity from its name at the time of use. `land` has the same pattern (`run.current.1` goes to `api::op_view` at `background.rs:195` after `history.execute`). Add a pin for a delete of a queued operation, and one for an undo of the `add_operation` of a queued operation.

## What is good

- The world stays on the session thread. A result lands through the History, and only if `still_current` is true.
- The refusals name the operation.
- The tests are in the existing `mcp` directory suite. No new test binary.
- No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!()` in the new source. `background.rs` has 327 lines and a provenance comment.

## Results, merged with main (built locally, no GitHub runner)

- Trial merge `614fa7272` against upstream/main `16115cd06`. `HEAD^1` is `c83ab4889`. The merge was clean. The newer main changed `cli.rs` and `mcp/mod.rs`; the build passes.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 170 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, 16.2 min. This includes `mcp`, `mcp_generate`, `mcp_live`, `example_catalog`, `first_part_programs`, `scripting` and `cli`.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp background_ -- --test-threads=1` on the restored source: 7 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Light lane: not run. The diff changes no generator, no post and no motion code, and the verdict is not clean. It is owed on the next head.
- Heavy lanes: not run (not a merge condition). The author reports one red heavy step, `app heavy: pocket3d_hsm` (5,232 facets against the Linux pin 6,228). The test and its fixture have the same blobs on upstream/main, so this PR does not cause it. I know of no issue that tracks it.

Extra suites run: none were necessary. The diff changes no file under `testdata/`, no golden and no importer.

Mutations run again locally (each restored afterwards; the worktree is clean):

- `mpsc::sync_channel(1)` changed to `1000`: `blocked_output_bounds_the_input_queue` RED ("reader consumed more than three lines while output was blocked"). Restored: GREEN.
- `running_name` ignores a cancelled run: `cancelled_workers_keep_the_worker_budget_until_they_finish` RED ("retry started another held worker"). Restored: GREEN.

Goldens moved: none. No recorded program changed. No UI file changed, so screenshots are not necessary. This is not a safety-tier diff: `v_generate` is split into `generate_targets` plus the same loop, and the catalog suites pass without a change.

## Optional, non-blocking

- `crates/app/src/script/api.rs` has 556 lines. It was more than 400 lines before this PR, and this PR adds 8.
- After a cancel, a retry gets "another generate is running" until the old worker finishes. For a long job this can be minutes. The decision record says so. The refusal text could say that the run was cancelled.

The review worktree and the `review-3860` branch stay in place to keep the build cache.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

- Fixed the retained-entity crash. The lane keeps names and resolves entities at use, including after History execution.
- Delete pin: `background_generate::a_deleted_queued_operation_is_skipped`.
- Undo pin: `background_generate::an_undone_queued_add_is_skipped`.

Each pin failed with SIGABRT without the fix. All nine background tests passed after restoration.

New head: `07e37adeb7a82b1bda741f8003251300db15a291`.

Quick gate: GREEN, 169 steps. App clippy: GREEN.
Light lane: GREEN, 5 steps. Heavy gate: RED, 64 steps, 1 failed, 0 stalled; 17.9 minutes.
`app heavy: pocket3d_hsm` failed the unchanged macOS pin. The PR body records the values and matching upstream blobs.
The catalog and reached golden suites passed. No recorded program changed.

Please re-review this head.

Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking finding remains.

## Earlier findings

The latest review was on `c83ab4889`. I checked its finding first and read the author's `Addressed:` comment.

1. **Retained-entity crash: fixed by `07e37adeb`.** `Running` keeps operation names only. `advance` resolves each entity before use. `land` resolves the current entity after History execution. Both requested pins passed locally: `background_generate::a_deleted_queued_operation_is_skipped` and `background_generate::an_undone_queued_add_is_skipped`.
2. **Worker budget after cancellation: still fixed.** A cancelled worker keeps the slot until completion. `cancelled_workers_keep_the_worker_budget_until_they_finish` passed.
3. **Input queue bound: still fixed.** The event channel has capacity one. `background_streams::blocked_output_bounds_the_input_queue` passed.
4. **Null-name and accepted-ID dispatch: still fixed.** `a_null_name_uses_the_background_lane_and_busy_guard` passed.
5. **Output error with open input: still fixed.** `background_streams::an_output_error_returns_while_input_remains_open` passed.

NeoTech's request for a linked issue is met. The body ends with `Refs #3035` for partial work.

## Local results

I read the complete diff against current upstream main and used that main's `AGENTS.md` for the law check.
The trial merge is `0823a351f427c8d84ec073c76f2740c8655b8220`.
The base is `aedd9750ce6b50457812389f400df1e1a71119ca`.
`HEAD^1` is the full PR head in the marker above. The merge was clean.

- `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1 CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=12 cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed. 170 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled; 16.7 minutes. The local build passed.
- `mcp`: 45 passed, including all nine background tests. `mcp_generate`: 2 passed. `mcp_live`: 19 passed. `cli`: 13 passed. `scripting`: 20 passed.
- `example_catalog`: 39 passed, 4 ignored. `first_part_programs`: 2 passed. The `adaptive_trochoid` golden suite: 12 passed.
- `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1 CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=12 cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main --only 'motion light:' --only 'app light:'`: passed. All 11 tests across five steps passed; 0 failed, 0 stalled; 5.4 minutes. Each selected target built through `cargo test`. The broad prebuild step was omitted.
- `CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache cargo clippy -j 12 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Extra suites run: no additional fixture-reader or importer suites were required. This PR changes no fixture, golden or importer.

## Scope and limits

This is not a safety-tier diff. It changes MCP scheduling and shares the existing target-selection loop. It changes no generator, geometry, simulation, collision check or post.
Goldens moved: none. No recorded program changed. No UI file changed, so screenshots are not required.

Mutations: not rerun in this round. The author records RED/GREEN proofs for both new crash pins. I ran both restored pins locally. I changed no source file.

Full heavy lanes were not run. Current upstream rules do not require them for this diff.
The author reports a red `pocket3d_hsm` heavy step on this head. I did not run that step or a bare-main comparison, and do not claim an independent baseline result.

The documented limits remain: cancellation drops the result but does not stop the generator. Rest-operation staging can still block the session. A blocked input thread can remain until input resumes or closes. The mould-core CLI run was not exercised. The remaining work stays on #3035.

The world stays on the session thread. Finished commands use History and the existing `still_current` guard. The new tests join the existing MCP suite.

The worktree and `review-3860` branch remain in place to keep the build warm. The tree is clean. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
